entities.summary: Vladimir Imamovich Norov is an Uzbek politician who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs of Uzbekistan from 2006 to 2010 and again from 27 April to 30 December 2022 and Former Secretary-General of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation from 2019 to 2021.
